question: What are the trunks made of?
html:
Our swim trunks are made from recycled plastic bottles, at about 11 bottles per trunk, and the brand counts roughly 26M bottles recycled through 2021 (Fair Harbor public filings). The exact fiber blend, liner and trim materials are not in the data we have here, so we won't guess at them.

What we can confirm

  • Source material: recycled plastic bottles (Fair Harbor public filings).
  • Bottles per trunk: about 11. This figure appears in our filings research as a basis for estimating sales, so treat any per-style count as est.
  • Cumulative impact: about 26M bottles through 2021 (Fair Harbor public filings).
  • Brand commitment: Fair Harbor is a public benefit corporation. The growth plan positions it as a year-round sustainable lifestyle brand (Fair Harbor growth plan).

Known and unknown details

ItemWhat we knowWhere the answer lives
Bottles per trunk~11 (est. per style)Fair Harbor public filings
Bottles recycled through 2021~26MFair Harbor public filings
Fiber blend (% recycled, % stretch)Not in our dataPer-style fabric spec sheets
Liner, waistband, drawcordNot in our dataCare labels, supplier specs
Non-swim lines (golf, kids, collegiate)Not in our dataMerchandising tech packs

Scope of this answer

  • It covers swim trunks only.
  • 64.0% of the 372 live products are non-swim (Fair Harbor growth plan). We have no material data for those lines, so we can't say whether they use the same recycled fabric.
  • Recycled-content certifications from suppliers would confirm the bottle claim style by style. Fabric spec sheets would confirm the blend.

Swim is the most-returned category at Shopify brands (21.6%), so clear material and fit details on every product page support the returns and margin work that leads the first six months of the growth plan (Fair Harbor growth plan).

Next actions

  1. Pull fabric spec sheets for every live trunk style. Publish the fiber blend and liner material on each product page.
  2. Confirm the 11-bottles-per-trunk figure by style with merchandising before it goes into new marketing copy.
  3. Load verified material data into the knowledge base for the fit and CX agents, so customer answers come from source records.
  4. Check recycled content for the golf, kids and collegiate lines, and record what the data shows.
